string.value: I have read and agree to the

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_1
string.value: 1. Service description: This agreement applies to the "Ongoing Support" auto-renewable subscription offered in the TimelyNotify app. Subscribing is entirely voluntary and does not affect your use of the app's basic features.

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_2
string.value: 2. Term and price: The subscription term is 1 year. Prices are as shown on the in-app subscription page and in Huawei checkout. Once subscribed, Huawei will charge your selected payment method.

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_3
string.value: 3. Auto-renewal: Within 24 hours before expiry, Huawei will automatically charge the next term via your bound payment method and extend the service period. The exact charge time is subject to Huawei In-App Purchases.

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_4
string.value: 4. Cancellation: You can cancel auto-renewal at any time via Settings → Huawei ID → Payment & bills → Subscriptions → TimelyNotify → Cancel subscription. After cancellation, the subscription will no longer renew. The fee paid for the current term is non-refundable, and benefits remain valid until the end of the current term.

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_5
string.value: 5. Price changes: If the subscription price changes, Huawei will notify you in-app or by message before renewal. If you do not accept the new price, you can cancel the subscription before renewal.

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_6
string.value: 6. Refunds: Subscription benefits are virtual goods delivered instantly and are generally non-refundable. If you are charged repeatedly due to a system error or do not receive the benefits, contact us via in-app Feedback or request after-sales support through Huawei In-App Purchases.

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_7
string.value: 7. Scope of benefits: Ongoing Support is a voluntary donation to the developer. It does not include additional paid features or content, and existing features remain free to use during the subscription term.

string.name: mine_donate_agreement_8
string.value: 8. Changes and contact: This agreement may be updated as the service evolves; updates will be published in the app. If you have any questions, contact us via in-app Feedback.

string.name: mine_donate_cancel_note
string.value: After cancellation, auto-renewal stops and benefits remain valid until the end of the current period.
